description: Returns the 442 League Index of one league (its slug from resolve), or of the top 1 to 20 European leagues (default 10): 0.6 x the mean 442ball Power Rating of the league's top 6 clubs (top 4 in a league of 12 or fewer) + 0.4 x the mean of all its clubs, in rating points, with both parts and the league page URL. A European league carries its rank among European leagues; a league elsewhere carries no rank yet.
name: league_index
title: A league's 442 League Index
